name: Runner Extras - TestPage Editable/Enabled
brief: Pins that TestPage field.Editable(), field.Enabled() and action.Enabled() report the page's real state instead of a constant true.
description: AL guards read-only rows with control properties — 'Editable = false' for a permanently locked control and 'Editable = SomeVar' for one that depends on the row. A TestPage that answers true unconditionally cannot fail such a test, so the whole read-only contract of a page goes untested and a regression that makes protected data writable ships green.
